name: Paper 3 - Regime A - HDPE/WO3 phi=0.189 (63.7 wt%)
description: Regime-A (effective-medium) benchmark for the second paper-3 material: HDPE/WO3 at volume fraction phi=0.189. This gives 63.72 wt% WO3 / 36.28 wt% HDPE at rho_eff=2.124 g/cm3 (self-consistent via linear mixture rule with rho_f=7.16, rho_m=0.95). The W K-edge at 69.5 keV falls between the 50 and 80 keV grid points, providing independent K-edge coverage relative to the Bi2O3 study (Bi K-edge 90.5 keV). Validates the effective-medium approximation for a second filler chemistry.

paper3.notes: Second-material companion to paper3_hdpe_bi2o3_regime_a_phi0p189. Uses same phi=0.189 and same energy grid to enable direct cross-material comparison. W K-edge (69.5 keV) is resolved between 50 and 80 keV grid points.
